<!--
  The promises of a store in one band: free delivery, returns, warranty, help. Axes: layout (strip: one muted
  panel, cards: a card each, bar: a thin line of icons and titles), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type UspStripProps = {
    id: string;
    title?: string;
    perks: Feature[];
    layout?: "strip" | "cards" | "bar";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title = "",
    perks,
    layout = "strip",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: UspStripProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density}>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "bar")}
    <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-8 gap-y-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each perks as p (p.id)}
        <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium" data-testid="item">
          <LucideIcon name={p.icon} size={16} />
          <Inline>
            {p.title}
          </Inline>
        </ListItem>
      {/each}
    </List>
  {:else}
    <Grid
      cols="1-4"
      class={cn("gap-4", (((layout as string) === "strip") ? "rounded bg-muted p-6" : ""))}
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each perks as p (p.id)}
        <Stack
          gap="4"
          class={(((layout as string) === "cards") ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" : "")}
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
            <LucideIcon name={p.icon} size={20} />
          </Box>
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {p.title}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {p.text}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
